content:
The investigation traced the flow of INR 4,70,000 originating from seed wallet 0xa7f39c1d8e4b2a5f7c3d9e0a1b8c6d4e5f2a67e9 on 2026‑09‑08 at 10:31:04 +05:30. Fourteen distinct entities were identified across seventeen transfers, with a maximum depth of three hops. Sixteen transfers were confirmed and one inferred correlation was noted. The fund moved rapidly, with the first outbound transaction occurring three minutes after receipt, passing through address E04, a mixer contract (0x8589f2c47b1d0a63e95482f7ca1b3d6e0f4a0b6f) handling 1,500 USDT, and subsequently reaching a cross‑chain bridge (0xbb17d4a09e26c35f81b0d7a94e13c68f05b2c530) within two downstream hops. Sixteen of the transfers met or exceeded the 30 % reporting threshold, one fell below it.

Risk scoring assigned the seed wallet a high score of 65/100, reflecting proximity to a known scam cluster (+20), rapid automated dispersal (+15), mixer interaction (+15) and bridge exposure (+15). The highest‑scoring entity observed was 0x9c04a7e3b21d5f86c0a94e7d2b83f150c6ead21e with a critical score of 75/100; the seed wallet remained at 65/100, and another entity scored 35/100 (medium).
